category_edits.rationale: Scale history embeddings by fixed inverse-frequency weights computed solely from each category's training interactions. This may reduce dominance by frequent history items while preserving learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer. A persistent buffer saves the feature weights in each checkpoint; the generated predictor imports the updated model class and restores them automatically.

counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1)
    positive_counts = counts[1:][counts[1:] > 0]
    median_frequency = float(np.median(positive_counts)) if positive_counts.size else 1.0
    frequency_weights = np.clip(
        np.maximum(counts.astype(np.float64) / median_frequency, 1e-12) ** (-0.15),
        0.5, 2.0,
    ).astype(np.float32)
    frequency_weights[0] = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
